behavior: A wrapper drops an attribute that names a prop of the inner part unless the wrapper declares that prop. Thus `ContextMenu.Root` gives `Menu.Root` no `handle`, `triggerId`, `defaultTriggerId`, `modal` or `closeParentOnEsc`. Base UI passes all props of `ContextMenu.Root` to `Menu.Root`. Its type omits `handle`, `triggerId`, `defaultTriggerId` and `modal`, and declares `closeParentOnEsc` only as a deprecated prop.
